name: accountable-agent
description: Give an AI agent on Hedera a human guardian, a verifiable identity and guardian-approved spending rules, set up in the browser. The agent swaps on SaucerSwap, pays x402 services now or on a schedule, and sells signed standing and LLM inference over x402.

steps.text: Starts the dashboard (:3000), the standing API (:3001) and the local agent runtime (:3002). Missing local keys are generated into ignored .env files and never printed.

sections.title: 2. Set up your agent in the browser

steps.text: Connect HashPack with an ECDSA testnet account holding about 50 HBAR; it becomes the guardian. Approve four transactions: fund the setup account, create the HCS topic, allow SAUCE and USDC, approve the agreement. The agent runtime does the rest.

sections.title: 3. Fund the agent and use it

steps.text: Step 9 funds the agent: HBAR and SAUCE from the setup account, USDC from Circle's testnet faucet. Once funded it is live: swap on Optional DEX, pay x402 services on Pay services, sell LLM inference with your own provider key, and sell paid standing at /standing/:id.
